name: ERTH 3330
title: Active Tectonics
description: Tectonic processes that shape the Earth's surface, particularly its landforms.  Emphasis on short-term processes that produce disasters and catastrophes and affect human society. Formerly offered as ERTH 4330.
requirement_description: ERTH 1050; or both ERTH 1052 and one of ERTH 1010 or 1051 or 1055 or 1070 or GEOG 1070; or GEOG 2300E; or consent of instructor. Recommended preparation: ERTH 3020 and 3030.
